latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Overlay Creator.

- Add text, logo, or graphic overlays to uploaded video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Connects to a cloud GPU backend for fast 1080p MP4 exports.
- Automatic setup with free credits for new users (no account required).
- Simple workflow: upload, describe your desired overlays, download the finished result.
- Supports session-based editing, timeline previews, and batch processing.
- Robust error handling and easy-to-follow user prompts.
